statements.heading: The script
statements.text:
if docker_ok; then
  while read -r id name ips; do
    CID_NAME[$id]=${name#/}
    for ip in $ips; do CIP_NAME[$ip]=${name#/}; done
  done < <(docker ps -q | xargs -r docker inspect \
             --format '{{.Id}} {{.Name}} {{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}} {{end}}')
fi

statements.heading: The script
statements.text:
unit_of() {                       # PID -> systemd unit or scope (from the cgroup path)
  local cg
  cg=$(sed -n 's|^0::||p' "/proc/$1/cgroup" 2>/dev/null)                                   # cgroup v2
  [ -n "$cg" ] || cg=$(sed -n 's|^[0-9]*:name=systemd:||p' "/proc/$1/cgroup" 2>/dev/null)  # cgroup v1
  if [ -n "$cg" ]; then basename "$cg"; else echo "-"; fi
}

container_of() {                  # PID -> container / pod name, or "-"
  local pid=$1 comm cg id ip name=""
  comm=$(cat "/proc/$pid/comm" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ "$comm" = "docker-proxy" ]; then                       # host side of a -p mapping
    ip=$(tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$pid/cmdline" | grep -oE -- '-container-ip [^ ]+' | cut -d' ' -f2)
    if [ -n "$ip" ]; then echo "${CIP_NAME[$ip]:-ip:$ip}(docker-proxy)"; else echo "docker-proxy"; fi
    return
  fi
  [ "$comm" = "dockerd" ] && { echo "swarm-ingress"; return; }
  cg=$(cat "/proc/$pid/cgroup" 2>/dev/null)
  id=$(grep -oE '(docker|cri-containerd|libpod)-[0-9a-f]{64}' <<<"$cg" | head -n1 | grep -oE '[0-9a-f]{64}')
  [ -n "$id" ] || id=$(grep -oE '/(docker|kubepods)/.*[0-9a-f]{64}' <<<"$cg" | grep -oE '[0-9a-f]{64}$' | head -n1)
  [ -n "$id" ] || { echo "-"; return; }
  name=${CID_NAME[$id]:-}
  if [ -z "$name" ] && have crictl; then
    name=$(crictl inspect "$id" 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 -oE '"io.kubernetes.pod.name": *"[^"]+"' | cut -d'"' -f4)
    [ -n "$name" ] && name="pod:$name"
  fi
  echo "${name:-cid:${id:0:12}}"
}

statements.text:
listeners() {
  row PROTO ADDRESS:PORT PID PROCESS UNIT CONTAINER CONNS LOG_HINT
  ss -Htulpn | while read -r proto _state _rq _sq local _peer users; do
    local pid name unit svc ctr hint conns port
    users=${users:-}; port=${local##*:}; svc=""
    pid=$(grep -oE 'pid=[0-9]+' <<<"$users" | cut -d= -f2 | sort -n | head -n1)
    conns="-"
    [ "$proto" = "tcp" ] && conns=$(ss -Htn state established "( sport = :$port )" | wc -l)
    if [ -z "$pid" ]; then
      row "$proto" "$local" - "(no process: kernel socket, or not root)" - - "$conns" -
      continue
    fi
    name=$(cat "/proc/$pid/comm" 2>/dev/null || echo "?")
    unit=$(unit_of "$pid"); ctr=$(container_of "$pid"); hint=$(log_hint "$pid" "$unit" "$ctr")
    if [ "$pid" = 1 ]; then                                  # PID 1 holds it = socket activation
      read -r unit svc < <(systemctl list-sockets --no-legend 2>/dev/null \
                             | awk -v p=":$port" '$1 ~ p"$" {print $2, $3; exit}') || true
      unit=${unit:-"?.socket"}; hint="journalctl -u ${svc:-?}"
    fi
    row "$proto" "$local" "$pid" "$name" "$unit" "$ctr" "$conns" "$hint"
  done
}

rule_owned() {
  row SOURCE PORT TARGET
  if docker_ok; then
    docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Ports}}' | while IFS=$TAB read -r n p; do
      grep -oE '[0-9]+->[0-9]+/(tcp|udp)' <<<"$p" | sort -u | while read -r m; do
        row docker-publish "${m%%->*}/${m##*/}" "$n:${m#*->}"
      done
    done
    docker service ls --format '{{.Name}}\t{{.Ports}}' 2>/dev/null | while IFS=$TAB read -r n p; do
      grep -oE '[0-9]+->[0-9]+/(tcp|udp)' <<<"$p" | sort -u | while read -r m; do
        row swarm-publish "${m%%->*}/${m##*/}" "service $n:${m#*->}"
      done
    done
  fi
  if have iptables-save; then
    iptables-save -t nat 2>/dev/null | awk -v OFS='\t' '
      /^-A KUBE-NODEPORTS/ && /--dport/ { c="-"; d="-"
        for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) { if ($i == "--comment") c = $(i+1); if ($i == "--dport") d = $(i+1) }
        gsub(/"/, "", c); print "k8s-nodeport", d, c }
      /^-A CNI-DN-/ && /--to-destination/ { d="-"; t="-"
        for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) { if ($i == "--dport") d = $(i+1); if ($i == "--to-destination") t = $(i+1) }
        print "k8s-hostport", d, t }
      /-j REDIRECT/ && /--to-ports/ { d="-"; t="-"
        for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) { if ($i == "--dport") d = $(i+1); if ($i == "--to-ports") t = $(i+1) }
        print "redirect", d, "local port " t }' | sort -u
  fi
  if have ipvsadm; then
    ipvsadm -Ln 2>/dev/null | awk -v OFS='\t' '/^(TCP|UDP)/ {print "ipvs", $2, "virtual server"}'
  fi
}

statements.heading: Step H6 — Catch it in the act next time
statements.text:
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/slowcatch.sh > /dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Save evidence when CPU, memory or I/O pressure crosses a threshold.
set -u
OUTDIR=/var/tmp/slowcatch
THRESH=20                         # PSI "some avg10" percentage that triggers a capture
mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"
while true; do
  for r in cpu memory io; do
    v=$(awk '/^some/ {split($2, a, "="); print int(a[2])}' /proc/pressure/$r)
    if [ "$v" -ge "$THRESH" ]; then
      f="$OUTDIR/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)-$r.txt"
      {
        date; uptime
        head -n 2 /proc/pressure/cpu /proc/pressure/memory /proc/pressure/io
        vmstat -w 1 5
        iostat -xyz 1 3
        mpstat -P ALL 1 2
        ps -eo pid,ppid,user,state,%cpu,%mem,rss,wchan:24,etime,args --sort=-%cpu | head -30
        ps -eo state,pid,wchan:32,args | awk '$1 ~ /^D/'
        ss -s
      } > "$f" 2>&1
      find "$OUTDIR" -name '*.txt' -mtime +7 -delete     # keep one week (only this directory)
      sleep 300                                          # at most one capture per 5 minutes
    fi
  done
  sleep 10
done
EOF

Throughput baselines with iperf3
statements.text:
sudo tee /usr/local/bin/net-baseline.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage: net-baseline.sh TARGET_HOST   (needs: iperf3 + jq here, iperf3 + SSH key access on TARGET)
set -euo pipefail
TARGET=${1:?usage: net-baseline.sh TARGET_HOST}
OUT=/var/lib/net-baseline
mkdir -p "$OUT"
TS=$(date +%F-%H%M)
for dir in send recv; do
  ssh "$TARGET" 'iperf3 -s -1 -D'        # one-shot server, exits after the test
  sleep 1
  if [ "$dir" = recv ]; then R=-R; else R=; fi
  iperf3 -c "$TARGET" -t 10 -O 2 $R -J > "$OUT/$TS-$TARGET-$dir.json"
  printf '%s %s %s %.0f Mbit/s retrans=%s\n' "$TS" "$TARGET" "$dir" \
    "$(jq '.end.sum_received.bits_per_second / 1e6' "$OUT/$TS-$TARGET-$dir.json")" \
    "$(jq '.end.sum_sent.retransmits // 0' "$OUT/$TS-$TARGET-$dir.json")"
done | tee -a "$OUT/summary.log"
EOF

statements.text:
check_disk() {
  local label=$1; shift
  local use target
  # -P: one line per filesystem; -x: skip pseudo filesystems; NR > 1 skips the header
  while read -r use target; do
    if [[ $use == "-" ]]; then
      continue                              # e.g. vfat has no inode numbers
    fi
    use=${use%\%}                           # "91%" -> "91"
    if (( use >= DISK_WARN )); then
      warn "$label $target at ${use}% (threshold ${DISK_WARN}%)"
    else
      log OK "$label $target at ${use}%"
    fi
  done < <(df -P "$@" -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs -x squashfs -x overlay | awk 'NR > 1 {print $5, $6}')
}

statements.heading: Worked example: a server health report
statements.text:
check_memory() {
  local total avail used_pct
  total=$(awk '/^MemTotal:/ {print $2}' /proc/meminfo)       # kB
  avail=$(awk '/^MemAvailable:/ {print $2}' /proc/meminfo)   # kB, includes reclaimable cache
  used_pct=$(( (total - avail) * 100 / total ))
  if (( used_pct >= MEM_WARN )); then
    warn "memory ${used_pct}% used, $(( avail / 1024 )) MiB available"
  else
    log OK "memory ${used_pct}% used, $(( avail / 1024 )) MiB available"
  fi
}

  if (( ${#failed[@]} > 0 )); then

    case $opt in
      d) DISK_WARN=$OPTARG ;;
      m) MEM_WARN=$OPTARG ;;
      h) usage; exit 0 ;;
      *) usage; exit 2 ;;
    esac
  done
  if [[ ! $DISK_WARN =~ ^[0-9]+$ || ! $MEM_WARN =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    usage; exit 2
  fi

  log INFO "health report for $(hostname -f 2>/dev/null || hostname)"
  check_disk disk
  check_disk inodes -i
  check_memory
  check_failed_units
  if (( status == 0 )); then log INFO "result: OK"; else log INFO "result: WARN"; fi
  exit "$status"
}

statements.heading: Build your lab once
statements.text:
cat > ~/netlab.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# netlab.sh up|down  - client/router/server lab built from network namespaces
#   client 10.10.1.10/24 --- 10.10.1.1/24 [router] 10.10.2.1/24 --- 10.10.2.20/24 server
set -euo pipefail
case "${1:-}" in
  up)
    for ns in client router server; do
      ip netns add "$ns"
      ip -n "$ns" link set lo up
    done
    ip link add c-eth0 netns client type veth peer name r-eth0 netns router
    ip link add s-eth0 netns server type veth peer name r-eth1 netns router
    ip -n client addr add 10.10.1.10/24 dev c-eth0
    ip -n router addr add 10.10.1.1/24  dev r-eth0
    ip -n router addr add 10.10.2.1/24  dev r-eth1
    ip -n server addr add 10.10.2.20/24 dev s-eth0
    ip -n client link set c-eth0 up
    ip -n router link set r-eth0 up
    ip -n router link set r-eth1 up
    ip -n server link set s-eth0 up
    ip -n client route add default via 10.10.1.1
    ip -n server route add default via 10.10.2.1
    ip netns exec router sysctl -qw net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
    echo "lab up - test with: sudo ip netns exec client ping -c2 10.10.2.20"
    ;;
  down)
    for ns in client router server; do ip netns del "$ns" 2>/dev/null || true; done
    echo "lab removed"
    ;;
  *) echo "usage: sudo $0 up|down"; exit 1 ;;
esac
EOF

done

statements.heading: 7.3 Testing before DNS: curl --resolve and friends
7.3 Testing before DNS: curl --resolve and friends
statements.text:
for name in shop.example.com www.shop.example.com wiki.example.com crm.example.com; do
  https=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 --resolve "$name:443:$EDGE" "https://$name/")
  http=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}->%{redirect_url}' --max-time 10 --resolve "$name:80:$EDGE" "http://$name/")
  cert=$(echo | openssl s_client -connect "$EDGE:443" -servername "$name" 2>/dev/null \
         | openssl x509 -noout -issuer -enddate 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ')
  printf '%-22s https=%s  http=%s  %s\n' "$name" "$https" "$http" "$cert"
done

statements.heading: 8.2 Put Traefik in front with Docker Compose
8.2 Put Traefik in front with Docker Compose
statements.text:
cat > compose.yaml <<'EOF'
services:
  traefik:
    # pin a v3 minor you have tested. Use v3.6 or newer: older minors' Docker
    # provider fails on Docker Engine 29+ ("client version 1.24 is too old");
    # Dokploy's installer currently pins a v3.6.x release too
    image: traefik:v3.6
    restart: unless-stopped
    command:
      - --entrypoints.web.address=:80
      - --entrypoints.websecure.address=:443
      - --providers.file.directory=/etc/traefik/dynamic
      - --providers.file.watch=true
      - --providers.docker=true
      - --providers.docker.exposedbydefault=false
      - --api.insecure=true
      - --log.level=INFO
      - --accesslog=true
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
      - "127.0.0.1:9080:8080"
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - ./dynamic:/etc/traefik/dynamic:ro
  whoami:
    image: traefik/whoami
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.routers.whoami.rule=Host(`whoami.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.whoami.entrypoints=web
      - traefik.http.services.whoami.loadbalancer.server.port=80
EOF

EOF

statements.heading: Lab: build a bridge by hand with ip netns
statements.text:
for ns in red blue; do
  sudo ip link add "veth-$ns" type veth peer name "veth-$ns-br"
  sudo ip link set "veth-$ns" netns "$ns"
  sudo ip link set "veth-$ns-br" master br-lab
  sudo ip link set "veth-$ns-br" up
  sudo ip netns exec "$ns" ip link set lo up
  sudo ip netns exec "$ns" ip link set "veth-$ns" up
done

name: dep
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    environment: { POSTGRES_PASSWORD: labonly }
    healthcheck:
      # -h 127.0.0.1: during first-run init the image starts a temporary server on the Unix
      # socket only; a socket check would report "ready" before TCP clients can connect
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres"]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 15
  client:
    image: postgres:16
    depends_on:
      db: { condition: service_healthy }
    environment: { PGPASSWORD: labonly }
    command: ["psql", "-h", "db", "-U", "postgres", "-c", "select 'connected'"]
EOF

  - name: logs

sudo tee /usr/local/bin/sixty-seconds >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 60-second performance checklist (read-only). Usage: sudo sixty-seconds [samples]
# (sudo because Ubuntu restricts dmesg to root: kernel.dmesg_restrict=1)
N=${1:-5}
run() { printf '\n===== %s =====\n' "$*"; "$@"; }
run uptime
printf '\n===== dmesg -T | tail =====\n'; dmesg -T | tail -n 15
run vmstat 1 "$N"
run mpstat -P ALL 1 "$N"
run pidstat 1 "$N"
run iostat -xz 1 "$N"
run free -m
run sar -n DEV 1 "$N"
run sar -n TCP,ETCP 1 "$N"
printf '\n===== top -b -n 1 | head -20 =====\n'; top -b -n 1 | head -20
EOF

statements.heading: Step 1 — Start a hidden load
statements.text:
sudo tee /usr/local/bin/mystery-load >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Starts one random load for 5 minutes and records the answer in a root-only file.
set -euo pipefail
N=$(nproc)
AVAIL_MB=$(free -m | awk '/^Mem:/{print $7}')
case $(( RANDOM % 6 )) in
  0) ANSWER="CPU saturation"
     CMD=(stress-ng --cpu $(( N * 2 )) --timeout 300s) ;;
  1) ANSWER="memory (swapping)"
     CMD=(stress-ng --vm 1 --vm-bytes $(( AVAIL_MB * 110 / 100 ))M --vm-keep --timeout 300s) ;;
  2) ANSWER="disk (synchronous writes)"
     CMD=(stress-ng --hdd 2 --hdd-opts dsync --temp-path /var/tmp --timeout 300s) ;;
  3) ANSWER="kernel %sys (context switches)"
     CMD=(stress-ng --switch "$N" --timeout 300s) ;;
  4) ANSWER="network stack (%soft and %sys, loopback TCP)"
     CMD=(stress-ng --sock "$N" --timeout 300s) ;;
  5) ANSWER="cgroup CPU throttling (host looks idle)"
     CMD=(systemd-run --scope --unit=mystery-throttle -p CPUQuota=20% stress-ng --cpu "$N" --timeout 300s) ;;
esac
echo "$(date -Is) ${ANSWER} :: ${CMD[*]}" >> /root/mystery-answers.log
chmod 600 /root/mystery-answers.log
nohup "${CMD[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
echo "A load is running for 5 minutes. Start the clock and begin Step 2."
EOF

statements.text:
case "$choice" in
  1) what="unit $APP_UNIT fails: drop-in points ExecStart at a missing config"
     mkdir -p "/etc/systemd/system/$APP_UNIT.d"
     printf '[Service]\nExecStart=\nExecStart=/usr/local/bin/shop-worker --config /etc/shop/missing.yml\n' \
       > "/etc/systemd/system/$APP_UNIT.d/99-gameday.conf"
     systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl restart "$APP_UNIT" || true
     undo="rm /etc/systemd/system/$APP_UNIT.d/99-gameday.conf; systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl restart $APP_UNIT" ;;
  2) what="/var filled to about 90% by /var/tmp/.gameday-fill"
     size_kb=$(df --output=size -k /var | tail -1); avail_kb=$(df --output=avail -k /var | tail -1)
     fill_kb=$(( avail_kb - size_kb / 10 ))
     (( fill_kb > 0 )) || { echo "disk already above 90%, rerun with another scenario" >&2; exit 1; }
     fallocate -l "${fill_kb}K" /var/tmp/.gameday-fill
     undo="rm -f /var/tmp/.gameday-fill" ;;
  3) what="Traefik route for shop points at port 8001 instead of 8000 (502)"
     cp -a "$ROUTE_FILE" "/root/.gameday-route.bak"
     sed -i 's/:8000"/:8001"/' "$ROUTE_FILE"
     undo="cp -a /root/.gameday-route.bak $ROUTE_FILE" ;;
  4) # assumes Traefik publishes 443 through Docker; with host networking use the INPUT chain instead
     what="DOCKER-USER drops HTTPS from the monitoring host $MONITOR_IP (UFW would not: Docker-published ports bypass it)"
     iptables -I DOCKER-USER -s "$MONITOR_IP" -p tcp -m conntrack --ctorigdstport 443 -j DROP
     undo="iptables -D DOCKER-USER -s $MONITOR_IP -p tcp -m conntrack --ctorigdstport 443 -j DROP" ;;
  5) replicas=$(docker service inspect "$SWARM_SERVICE" --format '{{.Spec.Mode.Replicated.Replicas}}')
     what="Swarm service $SWARM_SERVICE scaled from $replicas to 0"
     docker service scale "$SWARM_SERVICE=0" >/dev/null
     undo="docker service scale $SWARM_SERVICE=$replicas" ;;
  6) what="CPU saturated for 30 min by transient unit gameday-stress"
     systemd-run --unit=gameday-stress --collect stress-ng --cpu 0 --cpu-load 95 --timeout 30m >/dev/null
     undo="systemctl stop gameday-stress" ;;
  *) echo "unknown scenario $choice" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

retry() {
  local max=5 attempt=1 delay
  until "$@"; do
    if (( attempt >= max )); then echo "giving up after $attempt attempts: $*" >&2; return 1; fi
    delay=$(( 2 ** attempt + RANDOM % 3 ))
    echo "attempt $attempt failed, retrying in ${delay}s" >&2
    sleep "$delay"; (( attempt++ ))
  done
}
